info.title: OECP admin API
info.description:
Administration API of the dashboard (spec §8): invitations, organizations and their administrators, Channel A integration settings and sync runs, Channel B CSV uploads, Channel C course and offering writes with overrides, network status and maintenance jobs. Bearer-only (spec §4, `bearerAuth`); the roles allowed on each operation are listed in the extension `x-oecp-roles` (`partner_admin` limited to its organization and sub-units, `alliance_admin` everywhere, `role-less` a valid token without OECP roles, `anonymous` no token).

**Rate limits.** 30 requests/s per client address (burst 60) at the edge proxy (spec §10), plus the application limits of `sync-now` and CSV uploads (429 with `Retry-After`).

**Versioning.** Consumed by the dashboard of the same release; changes are listed in the CHANGELOG with a minor version note. External clients are not supported before 1.0 (`docs/RELEASING.md`).

**Conventions.** JSON members are snake_case (as the database); multilingual short labels are objects `{en, <lang>…}` that always contain `en`; dates are `YYYY-MM-DD` local to the offering `timezone`, timestamps ISO 8601 UTC; absent values are `null`, never omitted. Every error is RFC 9457 `application/problem+json` (`ProblemDetails`) with stable codes in `errors[].code` (spec §6.6, Appendix A).

The schemas are generated from the Zod contracts of `@oecp/schemas`, the single source of truth the API validates with. The OEAPI v5-compatible read API under `/oeapi/v5` (spec §9) is not described here: it follows the OEAPI v5.0 standard and its own OpenAPI document.

get.summary: Get the history of a course
get.description: Changes of the course and its offerings, newest first: ingest rows (accepted or rejected payloads, body not included) and audit rows, each with a one-line summary.

put.summary: Upload or replace the course image
put.description: Decision 27: one image per course, stored by OECP. `multipart/form-data` with `file` (JPEG, PNG or WebP, sniffed from the bytes; at most 5 MiB and 40 megapixels), `alt_en` (required unless `decorative=true`, at most 300 characters), `decorative` (`true`/`false`, default `false`) and `credit` (at most 300 characters). Re-encoded to WebP without metadata: `lg` inside 1600×1600 and `sm` inside 640×640, never upscaled; served at `/media/courses/{id}/{key}.lg.webp` and `.sm.webp`. Replaces (and deletes) the previous image. Works on harvested courses too: the harvester never touches the image. Audited `course.image_set`.

requestBody.description: The image file and its text parts; no other parts. The type is sniffed from the bytes, not taken from the part header.

file.description: JPEG, PNG or WebP, at most 5 MiB and 40 megapixels.

alt_en.description: English alternative text; required unless `decorative` is `true`.

decorative.description: Purely decorative image (rendered with an empty alternative text).

credit.description: Credit shown under the image (photographer, licence…).

400.description: Missing `file` part, unexpected parts or invalid text parts: `oecp.request.validation_failed`.

404.description: Unknown course (or one outside the caller scope): `oecp.request.not_found`.

415.description: Not a JPEG, PNG or WebP image: `oecp.media.unsupported_type`.

422.description: No English alternative text on a non-decorative image: `oecp.media.alt_required`; image that cannot be decoded, over 40 megapixels or over 2 MiB once re-encoded: `oecp.media.invalid_image`.

patch.summary: Change the alternative text, decorative flag or credit of the course image
patch.description: Metadata only; `alt` replaces the whole map (keys are primary language subtags). The result must be decorative or have an English text. Audited `course.image_set`.

404.description: Unknown course (`oecp.request.not_found`) or a course without image (`oecp.media.not_found`).

422.description: No English alternative text on a non-decorative image: `oecp.media.alt_required`.

delete.description: Deletes the files and clears the image; the portal falls back to the partner logo. Audited `course.image_removed`.

`alliance_admin`: every organization (deleted ones with `include_deleted=true`); `partner_admin`: its organization and sub-units. Alliance first, then partners, then other organizations; by slug within each group.

get.summary: List the sync runs of an organization

404.description: Unknown organization (or one outside the caller scope): `oecp.request.not_found`.

post.description: `multipart/form-data` with the file parts `courses` and/or `offerings` (template 1.3; 1.0, 1.1 and 1.2 accepted; `image_url` cells are fetched asynchronously after a successful run, failures are warnings `oecp.media.fetch_failed` added to the run), at most 5 MB each; no other parts. All or nothing (ADR-0011): uploads with at most 500 data rows are processed in the request (201, or 422 when validation fails and nothing is written), larger ones are queued (202). `Location: /api/admin/v1/sync-runs/{id}` is set on every response that has a run (201, 202, 422, 503).

requestBody.description: At least one of the file parts `courses` and `offerings` (one file each, UTF-8 CSV, template 1.3; 1.0, 1.1 and 1.2 accepted). No other parts.

400.description: No file part: `oecp.csv.no_files`; another part or a second file: `oecp.csv.unexpected_file`.

404.description: Unknown organization (or one outside the caller scope): `oecp.request.not_found`.

409.description: The organization authoritative channel is not `csv`/`form`: `oecp.sync.channel_disabled`.

413.description: A file over the size limit: `oecp.csv.file_too_large`.

422.description: Inline run failed validation (`CsvUploadProblem`; nothing written); `Location` names the run.

503.description: Queue unavailable, the run was cancelled: `oecp.internal`; `Location` names the run.

get.summary: Get the reference lists of the browser CSV validator
get.description: The lists an upload of the organization is validated against on the server (spec §6.3), as plain sorted codes: ISCED-F broad fields, active delivery modes, `ext_id` of the non-deleted sub-units (`teaching_unit_code`) and of the non-deleted courses (`offerings.csv` `course_code`); `language_tags` is null (no list: any well-formed BCP 47 tag). Attribute definitions are in `GET /organizations/{orgId}/reference`. `Cache-Control: private, max-age=60`: refetch with `Cache-Control: no-cache` after an upload.

parameters.name: org
parameters.description: Organization id; default the caller's `org_id`. A partner administrator may name its organization or one of its sub-units.

404.description: Unknown organization (or one outside the caller scope): `oecp.request.not_found`.

get.summary: Get a sync run with its errors
get.description: The run, one page of its errors and warnings, and `handbook_incomplete` (courses of the run with `oecp.content.handbook_incomplete`).

404.description: Unknown run (or one outside the caller scope): `oecp.request.not_found`.

AdminCourse.description: Effective values plus `overrides`, `override_meta` and `source_values`; `completeness` applies the IT Handbook publication rule to the effective values.

AdminCsvReference.description: The lists the server validates a CSV upload of the organization against, for the browser validator (`csvReferenceDataFromAdminCsvReference` of `@oecp/schemas`).

AdminMe.description: The signed-in administrator; `roles` is empty before an invitation is accepted.

AdminOffering.description: Effective values plus `overrides`, `override_meta` (`{by, at}` per key) and `source_values` (the harvested or uploaded value of each overridden key).

CourseImage.description: The stored course image (decision 27). `source_url` is the CSV `image_url` it was fetched from (null for an upload). Never harvested, never an override.

CourseImagePatch.description: At least one member. `alt` replaces the whole map (primary language subtag → 1–300 characters); `credit` `null` or empty removes it.

CourseInput.description: Create (default status `draft`; `published` needs `texts.en`) or full replace. `withdrawn`/`cancelled` only through `…/status`. Texts are keyed by primary language subtag; empty optional texts become null.

CourseLevel.description: Study cycle (`levels[0]` is the primary one).

CourseOverridesPatch.description: `set` stores overrides, `clear` removes them (restoring the harvested value). Keys: `status`, `kind`, `levels`, `ects`, `teaching_hours`, `info_url`, `contact_email`, `attributes`, `isced_codes`, `instructors`, and `texts.<lang>.<field>` with field `title`, `abstract`, `description`, `learning_outcomes`, `prerequisites`, `assessment`, `mode_of_repetition`, `methods`, `literature`, `privacy_notice`, `remarks`, `keywords` (a new language needs its `title`). Values have the shape of the same member of the create body; at least one change, at most 100 keys in each of `set` and `clear`, no key in both.

CreateOrganizationInvitationRequest.description: As `CreateInvitationRequest`; the organization comes from the path.

CsvUploadInlineResponse.description: Upload processed in the request (201): the finished run and its warnings.

CsvUploadProblem.description: Failed inline upload (422): nothing was written. The run keeps the full error list (`GET /sync-runs/{sync_run_id}?page=…`); `errors` holds the first 1,000 errors and warnings.

ErrorCode.description:
Stable error code (spec §6.6, Appendix A; `packages/schemas/errors.json`). Codes are never renamed, reused or repurposed; new codes may be added in any release, so clients must tolerate unknown values.

**Request** (`oecp.request.*`, 3)

- `oecp.request.validation_failed`: Request validation failed
- `oecp.request.not_found`: Resource not found
- `oecp.request.not_implemented`: Not implemented

**Internal** (`oecp.internal`, 1)

- `oecp.internal`: Internal error

**Authentication and authorization (`/api/admin`)** (`oecp.auth.*`, 8)

- `oecp.auth.missing_token`: Bearer token required
- `oecp.auth.invalid_token`: Token is invalid or expired
- `oecp.auth.insufficient_acr`: Multi-factor authentication required
- `oecp.auth.no_role`: No OECP role assigned
- `oecp.auth.unknown_organization`: Organization does not exist
- `oecp.auth.idp_mismatch`: Identity provider does not match the organization
- `oecp.auth.forbidden_organization`: Organization outside your scope
- `oecp.auth.forbidden_role`: Your role does not permit this operation

**Invitations** (`oecp.invitation.*`, 4)

- `oecp.invitation.invalid`: Invitation is invalid or already used
- `oecp.invitation.expired`: Invitation has expired
- `oecp.invitation.mismatch`: Signed-in identity does not match the invitation
- `oecp.invitation.idp_not_enabled`: Identity provider not enabled

**Identity service (Keycloak)** (`oecp.identity.*`, 2)

- `oecp.identity.unavailable`: Identity service request failed
- `oecp.identity.conflict`: Conflicting account in the identity service

**Mail** (`oecp.mail.*`, 1)

- `oecp.mail.unavailable`: E-mail could not be sent

**Content rules (every channel)** (`oecp.content.*`, 29)

- `oecp.content.english_missing`: English title is required to publish
- `oecp.content.invalid_value`: Invalid value
- `oecp.content.date_order`: Dates are out of order
- `oecp.content.seats_exceed_capacity`: Seats exceed max_students
- `oecp.content.seats_without_timestamp`: seats_available requires seats_updated_at
- `oecp.content.duplicate_isced`: Duplicate ISCED code
- `oecp.content.unknown_isced_field`: Unknown ISCED broad field
- `oecp.content.unknown_delivery_mode`: Unknown delivery mode
- `oecp.content.unknown_teaching_unit`: Unknown teaching unit
- `oecp.content.unknown_session`: Unknown academic session
- `oecp.content.session_ignored` *(warning)*: Academic session unknown or invalid; the offering was stored without it
- `oecp.content.unknown_course`: Unknown course code
- `oecp.content.unknown_attribute`: Unknown attribute (not defined by the alliance)
- `oecp.content.invalid_attribute_value`: Attribute value does not match its definition
- `oecp.content.unknown_attribute_option`: Attribute value is not one of the defined options
- `oecp.content.invalid_code`: Codes start with a letter or digit and use letters, digits, . _ / - (≤ 200)
- `oecp.content.unsupported_language`: Language is not in the list of supported languages
- `oecp.content.duplicate_ext_id`: A record with this code already exists

IntegrationUpdateRequest.description: Full settings; omitted members take their defaults. `secret` is write-only: omitted keeps the stored credential, `null` deletes it, a string replaces it (`username:password` for `basic`, the token for `bearer`, the header value for `api_key_header`). `enabled` only with `authoritative_channel: oeapi`.

Invitation.description: An invitation; the token and its hash are never returned.

InvitationMismatchReason.description: Which check of `POST /invitations/accept` failed (problem member `reason` of `oecp.invitation.mismatch`): `email` (signed-in e-mail is not the invited address, 403), `idp` (not signed in through the organization IdP, 403), `home_organization` (the IdP did not assert the schacHomeOrganization, 403), `organization` (the account already administers another organization, 409).

LocalizedLabel.description: Short label keyed by BCP 47 language tag; always contains `en`. Clients show `label[locale] ?? label.en`.

OfferingInput.description: Create or full replace of an offering; `timezone` defaults to the organization default; `seats_available` stamps `seats_updated_at`.

OfferingOverridesPatch.description: `set` stores overrides, `clear` removes them (restoring the harvested value). Keys: `status`, `start_date`, `end_date`, `enrol_start_date`, `application_deadline`, `timezone`, `teaching_languages`, `delivery_modes`, `campus`, `max_students`, `alliance_seats`, `seats_available`, `application_url`, `application_instructions`. Values have the shape of the same member of the create body; at least one change, at most 100 keys in each of `set` and `clear`, no key in both.

OrganizationInput.description: `PUT` is a full replace: optional members left out become null. `slug` is immutable after creation. `partner_id`, `id` and timestamps are derived by the API.

PartnerIntegration.description: Channel A settings; the credential is never returned (`secret_configured`).

ProblemDetails.description: RFC 9457 `application/problem+json`, the body of every error response. `errors[]` lists stable codes; `instance` is the request path. Extension members: `reason` on `oecp.invitation.mismatch` (see `InvitationMismatchReason`), `idp_alias` on `oecp.invitation.idp_not_enabled`, `sync_run_id`/`run_status`/`error_count`/`warning_count`/`processed_inline` on failed inline uploads. Problems raised by the framework itself (e.g. a malformed UUID in the path) carry `title` and `status` without `errors`.

ProblemError.description: One error or warning: CSV problems carry `file`, `row` (1-based, header = 1) and `column`; JSON bodies an RFC 6901 `pointer`.

ResendInvitationRequest.description: `ttl_hours` defaults to the lifetime of the original invitation.

SourceChannel.description: Ingestion channel: `oeapi` (A, harvester), `csv` (B, upload), `form` (C, web form).

SyncRun.description: A sync run of any channel (harvest, CSV upload, form save).

SyncRunFiles.description: Original names of the files of a CSV upload, per file kind.

TestConnectionResult.description: Remote failures are `ok: false` with `error`, not HTTP errors.

OrgId.name: orgId
OrgId.description: Organization id. A malformed UUID answers 400.

OrganizationId.name: id
OrganizationId.description: Organization id. A malformed UUID answers 400.

InvitationId.name: id
InvitationId.description: Invitation id. A malformed UUID answers 400.

CourseId.name: id
CourseId.description: Course id. A malformed UUID answers 400.

OfferingId.name: id
OfferingId.description: Offering id. A malformed UUID answers 400.

SyncRunId.name: id
SyncRunId.description: Sync run id. A malformed UUID answers 400.

MaintenanceJobName.name: name
MaintenanceJobName.description: On-demand job name; other names answer 404.

Cache-Control.description: Set on successful responses only: `public, max-age=60` (search, suggest), `public, max-age=300` (course, reference, sitemap), `public, max-age=3600` (OpenAPI documents). Errors are never cached.

ETag.description: Weak entity tag of the body; send it back in `If-None-Match` to get a 304.

Location.description: Path of the created resource (uploads: the sync run, `/api/admin/v1/sync-runs/{id}`).

Content-Disposition.description: Suggested file name (`attachment` for templates, `inline` for the JSON Schema).

BadRequest.description: Malformed request: query, path or body shape (`oecp.request.validation_failed`, with a JSON pointer per error), or a malformed UUID in the path.

Unauthorized.description: No usable token: `oecp.auth.missing_token`, `oecp.auth.invalid_token` (signature, issuer, audience, `azp`, expiry), `oecp.auth.insufficient_acr` (no MFA; RFC 9470 step-up challenge in `WWW-Authenticate`).

Forbidden.description: Authenticated but not allowed: `oecp.auth.no_role`, `oecp.auth.unknown_organization` (`org_id` claim missing or not an active organization), `oecp.auth.idp_mismatch` (the `idp` claim is not the organization IdP), `oecp.auth.forbidden_role` (role not in `x-oecp-roles`), `oecp.auth.forbidden_organization` (organization outside the caller scope).
